summary: Full Stack Technical Lead with 10+ years building cloud-native enterprise applications for Walmart Global Tech, IBM / AEP and HCSC (HIPAA healthcare member platform, 1M+ members). Front ends in modern Angular (17+, TypeScript, RxJS, Signals, Reactive Forms, NgRx) and React; back ends in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, async services and background job processing) and Node.js exposing REST APIs and WebSocket real-time features over PostgreSQL, with Java / Spring Boot microservices where needed. Deploys on AWS (EKS/Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront) with Docker and Jenkins / GitHub Actions CI/CD, secures systems with JWT / OAuth 2.0 and role-based access, and monitors them in Dynatrace (cut P1 mean time to resolution by 50%). Leads technical design discussions and architecture reviews, drives code review and performance optimization, mentors teams of 4 to 7 engineers, and works directly with product managers and client stakeholders in Agile/Scrum. GitHub Copilot and Claude Code in daily use.
